description:
As a method actor, Do-Ha has always poured himself into his roles. For him, acting is an outlet he uses to deal with his difficult upbringing and the lingering struggles with self-worth that resulted from it. But one day, when Do-Ha collapses after filming only to wake up and find himself transmigrated into the world of the screenplay and inhabiting the very character he had been playing, his acting chops are about to be put to the test. Not only will Do-Ha have to give a convincing enough performance to fool everyone into believing he truly is the King’s concubine, he must also find a way to change the fate of his character who, according to the screenplay, is slated for an untimely demise. The only problem is, there’s just one way for Do-Ha to save his own neck, and that’s to win the affections of the King, who is proving to be a far cry from the gentleman he was written to be. Will Do-Ha somehow manage to come out unscathed, or will this be curtains for him?

(Source: Lezhin US)
